summary: Iter147 — Full-stack regression on the 4 RadioLife enhancements (language chip filter, admin restore panel, sponsored Play slot, better game art). 17/17 pytest cases PASS. Web + Mobile UI verified. Backend: /api/radio/browse `lang_group` filter reduces totals correctly (baseline=1756 imported; english/hindi/indian/news each strictly smaller than baseline; hindi=127 on `source=imported`, news=453 on `source=all` visible in the UI); `lang_group=all` behaves as a no-op equal to no filter. Admin: /api/admin/radio-import/hidden-summary returns total_hidden=3578, total_active=1742, by_country[] and by_language[] with {value,count}; hidden-stations?country=DE returns only DE rows; hidden-stations?q=radio ok; anon 401 on hidden-summary; restore scope=country value=ZZ returned restored:0 (SAFE no-op); invalid scope 400; reversible single-station toggle (set-active true → set-active false) leaves data as found. Promoted: /api/promoted/stations?limit=1 auto-seeds and returns Talk 100.3 UAE with promo_id + is_sponsored=true + sponsor_name; /api/promoted/{promo_id}/impression and /click both return ok:true. Web UI: /radio/browse renders all 5 chip data-testids (radio-browse-lang-group-all/english/hindi/indian/news); header total flips 1,756→127 on Hindi, 453 on News. Home '/' shows [data-testid=public-sponsored] pinned FIRST in the 'Tune in this second' rail with a SPONSORED badge on Talk 100.3 UAE (position x=372 = first column). /admin/radio-language (admin cookie) shows Hidden 3,578 / Active 1,742 stat cards, By Country chips (DE 392, RU 262, FR 203...), By Language chips (German 330, Spanish 298, French 226...), a searchable hidden-stations list with per-station Enable buttons, and a 'Re-enable all hidden' bulk button. Mobile UI: /games renders 5+ branded 1024x1024 game cover images (Featured Spin the Wheel + Quick Games Spin & Win/Music Trivia/Guess the Lyric + Trivia Challenge + Predict). /listen shows [data-testid=listen-sponsored] at the top with SPONSORED badge on Talk 100.3 UAE. /radio (after demo-login-btn) renders DiscoverBrowse chip row with all 5 testIDs radio-browse-lang-all/english/hindi/indian/news; Hindi chip highlights after tap (filter dispatch works; visible card count stays at 24 because both All and Hindi have >24 results paginated with limit=24 — backend already verified the filter works with hindi=127). No red-screen, no critical console errors (401s are the expected unauth pings from ad/personalization endpoints).
action_items: None — all 4 features (language chips, admin restore panel, sponsored slot, game art) work on both web and mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: radio_unified._merge_lang_group correctly folds the lang-group $or into an existing $and while preserving the active/flagship gate — good. Consider caching lang_group counts (cheap COUNT queries) on the browse response so the client can show real chip counts without a second call.

admin_radio_import.restore_hidden(scope='all') has NO safety guard — a single admin POST can mass-restore ALL 3,578 lang-hidden stations at once. Consider requiring an explicit confirm=true query param or a max_restore cap so a mis-click doesn't undo the whole language policy.

admin_radio_import.set_station_active(active=False) unconditionally marks lang_hidden:true, even for a station that was NEVER lang-hidden (e.g. an English UAE station manually disabled by admin). That semantically overloads lang_hidden with 'admin-disabled' — consider a separate admin_hidden:true flag so future audits can distinguish policy-hidden vs admin-disabled.

promoted/stations returns the same promo_id on every call once seeded (no rotation/randomization) — fine for a single sponsored slot, but if the roadmap adds multiple sponsors we'll need weighted rotation to avoid an unfair impression skew.

Frontend home rail sponsored card fires impression on mount and click on tap — no code review issues seen; the on-click event was received by the test harness (URL unchanged is expected for the sponsored preview card).
